outline.chapter_title: Chapter 1: Case Background and Procedural History
outline.description: This chapter establishes the factual and procedural context of Pacito v. Trump, detailing the Executive Order 14163, the plaintiffs' claims, the district court's preliminary injunctions, and the appellate court's history with the case to understand why a stay order is the appropriate immediate remedy.

outline.description: This chapter outlines the legal framework governing emergency stays pending appeal, explaining the four-factor test from Nken v. Holder and how the panel applies this standard to the specific immigration context.

outline.description: This chapter focuses on the merits of the challenge to Executive Order 14163, analyzing the President's authority under 8 U.S.C. § 1182(f) and the deferral to executive power established in Trump v. Hawaii.
